questionText: Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
explanation: Potential energy is a scalar quantity. Momentum, moment, and acceleration due to gravity are vectors.

Which of the following properties make the convex mirror useful as a driving mirror? I. The image is real  II. The image is erect  III. It has a wide field of view  IV. The image is magnified
explanation: A convex mirror is used as a driving mirror because the image formed is erect, virtual and diminished, and it has a wide field of view.

questionText: Dispersion of light occurs when light passes through a glass prism because of the

options.D: different speeds of the colours in the glass

explanation: Dispersion occurs because different colours (wavelengths) of white light travel through the component colours of the rainbow (ROYGBIV) at different speeds through the glass.

questionText: Which of the following remains unchanged when light travels from one medium to another?
explanation: From the formula \(V=f\lambda\), frequency is a parameter that remains constant/unchanged when light moves from one medium to another.

questionText: Three capacitors each of \(6\,\mu\text{F}\) are connected in series. The equivalent capacitance is
explanation: When capacitors are in series, equivalent capacitance \(=\dfrac{C}{n}=\dfrac{6}{3}=2\,\mu\text{F}\).
